The negative/blocked case scored 1/6 — the only passing expectation was "does not claim G1 pass" (trivially satisfied because the baseline has no G1 concept). Critically, the without_skill baseline for case-3 **fabricated a complete 7-day AI study plan** using model knowledge, demonstrating the exact failure mode the skill is designed to prevent.
